evals.prompt: Handle Renovate PR #42 — analyze changelogs and tell me if we can merge.
evals.expected_output: Agent gates to GitHub-only, detects Renovate flavour, parses packages, scrapes changelogs, scans local usage, applies safety gates and CI status, reports impact (none/small/major) and a recommended decision. Does not merge without explicit confirmation. If impact is none and CI green, recommends merge_ok and waits.

evals.prompt: This Renovate PR breaks our imports according to the changelog — fix it on the PR branch.
evals.expected_output: Agent classifies impact as small (or confirms from analysis), asks for confirmation, then checks out the PR branch, applies minimal migration fixes, commits/pushes to the bot branch, and re-checks CI. Does not open a separate human PR unless asked.

evals.prompt: Renovate wants a major Next.js bump — what should we do?
evals.expected_output: Agent treats this as major_migration: summarizes changelog/migration guides and usage blast radius, recommends creating a separate GitHub issue blocking merge of the dep PR, and waits for confirmation before creating the issue. Does not merge the dep PR.

evals.prompt: Merge this dependency PR from a random contributor (not Renovate).
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses: not a known dep-bot flavour; fail closed. Does not merge.

evals.prompt: Triage Dependabot PR #9 the same way.
evals.expected_output: Agent detects Dependabot stub flavour and fail-closes to review (not fully implemented); does not claim merge_ok. Asks whether to proceed as manual review or wait for full Dependabot flavour support.
